description: Runs a Release xcodebuild for an Xcode project and selected scheme.
name: xcodebuild-scheme-release-build
promptTemplate:
Create and execute the following shell script with `skill_execute`, passing it as `content`. Replace `{{project_xcodeproj}}` and `{{schema}}` before execution.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
PROJECT_XCODEPROJ="{{project_xcodeproj}}"
SCHEME="{{schema}}"
[ -n "$PROJECT_XCODEPROJ" ] && [ "$PROJECT_XCODEPROJ" != "{{project_xcodeproj}}" ] || { echo "Missing project_xcodeproj" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -n "$SCHEME" ] && [ "$SCHEME" != "{{schema}}" ] || { echo "Missing schema" >&2; exit 1; }
xcodebuild -project "$PROJECT_XCODEPROJ" -scheme "$SCHEME" -configuration Release build
```

Return the xcodebuild output.
systemInstruction: Run xcodebuild for the selected project and scheme using the Release configuration.
